#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Terminal Chess (two players) — ChatDev.

Features: full legal move generation, SAN input (e4, Nf3, exd5, O-O, e8=Q),
castling, en passant, promotion, check/checkmate/stalemate, 50-move rule,
threefold repetition, insufficient material, resignation, undo.
"""

import re
import sys

FILES = "abcdefgh"
RANKS = "12345678"
START = ("RNBQKBNR" "PPPPPPPP" "........" "........" "........" "........"
         "pppppppp" "rnbqkbnr")

def sqname(i):
    return FILES[i % 8] + RANKS[i // 8]

def parse_sq(s):
    if len(s) == 2 and s[0] in FILES and s[1] in RANKS:
        return RANKS.index(s[1]) * 8 + FILES.index(s[0])
    return None

class State:
    __slots__ = ("board", "turn", "castling", "ep", "halfmove", "fullmove")

    def __init__(self):
        self.board = list(START)
        self.turn = "w"
        self.castling = {"K", "Q", "k", "q"}
        self.ep = None
        self.halfmove = 0
        self.fullmove = 1

    def copy(self):
        s = State.__new__(State)
        s.board = self.board[:]
        s.turn = self.turn
        s.castling = set(self.castling)
        s.ep = self.ep
        s.halfmove = self.halfmove
        s.fullmove = self.fullmove
        return s

    def key(self):
        return "".join(self.board) + self.turn + "".join(sorted(self.castling)) + str(self.ep)
